es.s1_lead: Marca el nivel en cada dimensión. No es una calificación: ubica dónde está la operación y a dónde se quiere llevar. Cada dimensión que se quiera subir de nivel es una iniciativa del roadmap.
es.ctastrip_p: El Imberion Checkup radiografía la operación y entrega una matriz de iniciativas con business case y un playbook accionable. La puerta de entrada de bajo riesgo.
es.lvl1_d: A criterio, sin regla ni dato.
es.lvl2_d: Hay reglas y datos, pero no se siguen ni se explotan.
es.lvl3_d: Decisiones por valor y segmento, con guardrails y medición.
es.lvl4_d: Sugerencias en continuo, con simulación y un loop que aprende.
es.hero_h1:
RGM para CPG:
del sell-in ciego al sell-out gobernado.
es.hero_lead: El fabricante de consumo ve el sell-in al detalle y es casi ciego al sell-out, al anaquel y al gross-to-net real. El trade spend, la segunda línea del P&L, se concede como condición de hecho y se mide tarde y por agregado. Imberion hace visible la señal de río abajo y convierte las cinco palancas de RGM en decisiones gobernadas.
es.diag_note: El fabricante típico está en nivel 1 o 2 en trade spend y promociones, donde está la mayor recuperación. Hacer visible el sell-out y el gross-to-net es el habilitador que desbloquea las demás dimensiones.
es.s2_eyebrow: Lo que Imberion trae a CPG
es.s2_lead: Se aplica lo que la operación necesita, anclado al salto de nivel. Todos los productos del catálogo aplican a CPG; aquí, los de mayor tracción.

es.cell_5_2: El ABC existe pero no dirige la venta; innovación por intuición

es.cell_7_1: Solo se ve el sell-in; el sell-out y el anaquel son ciegos
es.cell_7_2: Se compra panel o scanner, pero no se convierte en señal operable
es.cell_7_3: Sell-out integrado y leído contra sell-in; disponibilidad en anaquel medida
es.cell_7_4: Sell-out, anaquel y shopper en continuo, alimentando precio, promo y mix

es.cap1_p: El habilitador número uno. La cascada de precio de lista a neto realizado, por cliente, canal y SKU, antes del cierre. Sin esto, precio, trade, promo y mix se deciden a ciegas.
es.cap2_p: El sell-out de cadenas, distribuidores, panel y scanner como señal operable, leída contra el sell-in. Se decide sobre demanda real: el SKU que vende pero no se reabastece y el que solo infló el sell-in.
es.cap3_p: Predictividad ex-ante que separa incremental de canibalización antes de lanzar. Se deja de financiar lo que solo adelanta o canibaliza. Es la bolsa más grande y más rápida.
es.cap4_p: Trade terms con pago por desempeño y retorno medido por cliente y tipo de apoyo. Reasignar el trade spend improductivo libera puntos de revenue neto sin recortar la inversión total.
es.cap5_p: El precio y la promoción de la competencia capturados en el punto de venta real, más white spaces y entrantes. Se detecta dónde se pierde por precio y dónde hay espacio para entrar.
es.cap6_p: La atención conversacional al canal y al shopper que toma pedidos, recomienda y da servicio 24/7. Baja el costo de servir y empuja el mix objetivo en cada reabasto.

en.s1_h2: Where does the commercial operation stand today?
en.s1_lead: Mark the level on each dimension. It is not a grade: it locates where the operation stands and where it should go. Each dimension to move up a level is an initiative in the roadmap.
en.diag_cta: Take it to an Imberion Checkup
en.ctastrip_h2: How far can the operation go?
en.ctastrip_p: The Imberion Checkup x-rays the operation and delivers an initiative matrix with a business case and an actionable playbook. The low-risk way in.
en.lvl1_d: By judgment, no rule or data.
en.lvl2_d: Rules and data exist, but go unfollowed and unused.
en.lvl3_d: Decisions by value and segment, with guardrails and measurement.
en.lvl4_d: Continuous suggestions, with simulation and a learning loop.
en.hero_h1:
RGM for CPG:
from blind sell-in to governed sell-out.
en.hero_lead: A CPG maker sees its sell-in in detail and is nearly blind to sell-out, to the shelf, and to real gross-to-net. Trade spend, the second line of the P&L, gets conceded as a fact of the channel and measured late and in aggregate. Imberion makes the downstream signal visible and turns the five RGM levers into governed decisions.
en.diag_note: The typical maker sits at level 1 or 2 on trade spend and promotions, where the biggest recovery is. Making sell-out and gross-to-net visible is the enabler that unlocks the other dimensions.
en.s2_lead: We apply what the operation needs, anchored to the level jump. Every product in the catalog applies to CPG; here are the ones with the most traction.
en.cell_1_1: Single list price; the most aggressive channel sets the floor
en.cell_1_2: Per-channel list that isn't followed; no price-pack architecture
en.cell_1_3: PPA / OBPPC by channel and occasion; KVIs and target net price
en.cell_1_4: Price and pack suggested by channel and occasion; elasticity simulated
en.cell_2_1: Gross billing is watched; real net isn't seen until close
en.cell_2_2: Gross-to-net in aggregate; the unprofitable SKU or customer surfaces late
en.cell_2_3: Waterfall by customer, channel and SKU; contribution with cost to serve
en.cell_2_4: Gross-to-net simulated before deciding; early erosion alerts
en.cell_3_1: Trade spend conceded as a fact of the channel, at discretion
en.cell_3_2: Uneven policy; spend is measured, not its return or its quid pro quo
en.cell_3_3: Trade terms with pay for performance; return measured by support type
en.cell_3_4: Trade spend simulated; ROI up front; each investment feeds the next
en.cell_4_1: Inherited calendar; volume moved is counted, not incremental
en.cell_4_2: Occasional post-mortem; no baseline or cannibalization split
en.cell_4_3: Ex-ante predictivity (incremental vs. cannibalization) and post per promotion
en.cell_4_4: Promotion optimized continuously; mechanic recommended by SKU and store
en.cell_5_1: We sell what the channel asks for; no SKU roles; tail unreviewed
en.cell_5_2: The ABC exists but doesn't steer the sale; innovation by hunch
en.cell_5_3: SKU roles; target mix by channel; tail rationalized; whitespace prioritized
en.cell_5_4: Mix recommended by order and channel; innovation guided by demand
en.cell_6_1: One model and one value proposition for every channel; no cost to serve
en.cell_6_2: Channels served by inertia; the distributor's sell-out invisible
en.cell_6_3: RtM by channel economics; value prop per channel; distributors tied to sell-out; Perfect Store
en.cell_6_4: Coverage and execution optimized continuously; next best action per outlet
en.cell_7_1: Only sell-in is seen; sell-out and the shelf are blind
en.cell_7_2: Panel or scanner is bought, but not turned into an operable signal
en.cell_7_3: Sell-out integrated and read against sell-in; on-shelf availability measured
en.cell_7_4: Sell-out, shelf and shopper continuous, feeding price, promo and mix
en.cell_8_1: Levers live in uncoordinated areas; nobody owns net revenue
en.cell_8_2: Documented processes, inconsistent execution; volume-only forecast
en.cell_8_3: RGM function owning net revenue; three-dimension forecast; variable aligned to mix
en.cell_8_4: Decisions traceable end to end; levers governed as a system that learns
en.cap1_p: The number-one enabler. The waterfall from list price to realized net, by customer, channel and SKU, before close. Without it, price, trade, promo and mix are decided blind.
en.cap2_p: Sell-out from chains, distributors, panel and scanner as an operable signal, read against sell-in. Decisions run on real demand: the SKU that sells but isn't restocked and the one that only inflated sell-in.
en.cap3_p: Ex-ante predictivity that splits incremental from cannibalization before launch. It stops funding what only pulls forward or cannibalizes. It's the biggest and fastest pool.
en.cap4_p: Trade terms with pay for performance and return measured by customer and support type. Reallocating unproductive trade spend frees points of net revenue without cutting total investment.
en.cap5_p: Competitor price and promotion captured at the real point of sale, plus white spaces and new entrants. It shows where price is lost and where there's room to enter.
en.cap6_p: The conversational service to channel and shopper that takes orders, recommends and serves 24/7. It lowers cost to serve and pushes target mix on every reorder.

pt.hero_h1:

do sell-in cego ao sell-out governado.
pt.hero_lead: O fabricante de consumo enxerga o sell-in em detalhe e é quase cego ao sell-out, à gôndola e ao gross-to-net real. O trade spend, a segunda linha do P&L, é concedido como condição de fato do canal e medido tarde e por agregado. A Imberion torna visível o sinal de jusante e transforma as cinco alavancas de RGM em decisões governadas.
pt.diag_note: O fabricante típico está no nível 1 ou 2 em trade spend e promoções, onde está a maior recuperação. Tornar visíveis o sell-out e o gross-to-net é o habilitador que destrava as demais dimensões.
